evals.expected_output: If Stitch MCP/SDK unavailable/unauthenticated/cannot-create-project/cannot-read-metadata, marks stage Blocked, does NOT auto-fallback to HTML; records recovery path for user to fix Stitch or approve route switch
assertions: If Stitch MCP/SDK is unavailable, unauthenticated, cannot create/update project, or cannot read metadata, output marks the stage as Blocked.
Output does NOT auto-fallback to HTML when Stitch fails.
stitch-prototype.md records the failure reason and a recovery path (fix Stitch or user-approve route switch).

evals.expected_output: Extracts page/frame list, entry, main flow, states, fields, real data, design-system basis, red lines from PRD '原型约束契约'; builds Stitch prompt; records PRD coverage matrix and >=3 state coverage
assertions: Output extracts page/frame list, entry, main flow, states, fields, real data, and red lines from the PRD '原型约束契约'.
Output builds a Stitch prompt containing page/frame, main flow, state coverage, real fields, sample data, design-system basis, and red lines.
stitch-prototype.md records a PRD coverage matrix mapping each constraint to Stitch evidence or gap, and at least 3 state coverage types.

evals.expected_output: Preferably uses run_stitch_prototype.mjs with real adapter; requires STITCH_API_KEY or STITCH_ACCESS_TOKEN + GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT; mock adapter only for E2E/contract testing; does not treat mock metadata as real Stitch project info
assertions: Output preferably uses run_stitch_prototype.mjs with the real adapter.
Output requires STITCH_API_KEY or (STITCH_ACCESS_TOKEN + GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT) for authentication.
The mock adapter is used only for E2E/contract testing; mock metadata is not treated as real Stitch project info.

evals.expected_output: Reads workflow_policy.prototype_route; if route is html but stitch invoked, requests explicit override + records explicit_override/reason/risk/recovery-path; does not silently proceed
assertions: If route is html but stitch-prototype was invoked, output requests explicit user override.
If proceeding under override, output records explicit_override, reason, risk, and recovery path in stitch-prototype.md.

evals.expected_output: Prototype tab embeds main review content (Stitch project info, screen/frame list, coverage matrix, state coverage, gaps, recovery actions); not only an external Stitch link; if prototype.html coexists, shows combined route
assertions: The Prototype tab embeds main review content (Stitch project info, screen/frame list, coverage matrix, state coverage, gaps, recovery actions).
The Prototype tab is NOT only an external Stitch link.
If prototype.html coexists in the same directory, the Prototype tab shows the combined route without overwriting each other.
